Name: Planning and Requirements
Notes: Initial study, scope definition, requirements identification, task distribution, and project organization.

Name: Project Kickoff and Scenario Review
Notes: Read the SAMS scenario and identify the main problem and project purpose.

Name: Define Scope, Objectives, and Stakeholders
Notes: Define the system scope, main objectives, and primary users.

Name: Identify and Organize System Requirements
Notes: Identify student, organizer, Student Affairs, and automatic system requirements.

Name: Distribute Roles and Organize Project Files
Notes: Assign responsibilities and agree on file names, folders, and review process.

Name: Prepare Initial Project Schedule
Notes: Prepare the first Gantt chart with activities, durations, and dependencies.

Name: Phase 1 Progress Report
Notes: Prepare, review, and submit the mid-project progress report by 26 July 2026 at 23:59.

Name: Draft the Mid-Project Progress Report
Notes: Write completed work, key decision, problems, next plan, member participation, review, and submission.

Name: Analysis and Design Deliverables
Notes: Complete the analysis and design tasks from prototyping through database design.

Name: Evolutionary Prototyping and Three Low-Fidelity Screens
Notes: Justify evolutionary prototyping and prepare three low-fidelity screens.

Name: Context Diagram and Level-0 DFD
Notes: Develop the context diagram and Level-0 DFD.

Name: Three Level-1 DFDs
Notes: Develop three Level-1 DFDs for three major processes.

Name: Use Case Model and Three Documented Use Cases
Notes: Prepare the complete use case model and document three use cases.

Name: Two UML Activity Diagrams
Notes: Develop two UML activity diagrams.

Name: UML Class Diagram
Notes: Develop the UML class diagram with attributes, methods, and relationships.

Name: Relational Database Design and 3NF
Notes: Design the relational database and normalize it up to Third Normal Form.

Name: Final Review and Submission
Notes: Integrate, review, format, and submit the final project by 9 August 2026 at 23:59.

Name: Integrate All Report Sections and Diagrams
Notes: Combine all report sections and diagrams in the official template.

Name: Final Consistency Review, Reflections, and Formatting
Notes: Review consistency, complete individual reflections, and prepare Word and PDF files.

Name: Final Project Submission — 09/08/2026 at 23:59
Notes: Submit the final Word and PDF project files by 9 August 2026 at 23:59.
